One day, while training stoically for the 
Japan Cup, Machikane Tannhauser received a 
letter from a reporter wearing round 
glasses.

The letter mentioned being encouraged by 
her time and time again. And that if 
Matikanetannhauser were some special girl, 
it wouldn't have been nearly as 
encouraging.

"The letter overflowed with gratitude, 
saying, 'That's why you are my 
protagonist.' From those words, Chairwoman 
Akikawa's 'It's precisely because it's you 
that you can give them a push'—"

She understood the meaning of those words. 
If she could become a "protagonist," she 
wanted to. And if possible, a 
"protagonist" for even more people!

That new dream strongly drives her 
forward. At the press conference, she 
declares she will become the "protagonist" 
at the "Japan Cup," drawing immense 
expectations!
